# CANDIDATE: LOW_VIX_RANGE_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts (low VIX + tight ATR) and price breaks out of the ensuing range with volume, the move tends to persist. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede significant moves, and a breakout with volume confirmation indicates institutional participation and reduced likelihood of a false breakout.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When VIX <12 and the 5‑bar ATR contracts to <0.15% of price, define a range as the highest high and lowest low of those 5 bars; enter long on a close above the range high with volume > average volume, or short on a close below the range low with volume > average volume. Exit shape: Stop placed at the opposite side of the range (structure stop), target 2R, with a runner trailed at 20% of ATR after 1R profit. Regime hint: Best in low‑volatility environments (VIX <12), avoiding the first and last 15 minutes of the session to reduce noise from opening/closing auctions.
